title: Development of biobased dynamic thiol–acrylate photopolymers: 3D-printed self-healing and shape memory materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49714-49727
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07879B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Viranchika Bijalwan, Sandra Schlögl, Sravendra Rana
Bio-based thiol–acrylate resins were synthesized, enabling digital light projection 3D printing of soft objects, which exhibited not only shape-reforming and healing properties but were also chemically recyclable and mechanically reprocessable.
